chk_class_sessions_cancel_coherence.name: chk_class_sessions_cancel_coherence
chk_class_sessions_cancel_coherence.value: (status = 'SCHEDULED' AND cancel_reason IS NULL AND cancelled_at IS NULL) OR (status = 'CANCELLED' AND cancel_reason IS NOT NULL AND cancelled_at IS NOT NULL)

chk_reservations_not_self_reschedule.name: chk_reservations_not_self_reschedule
chk_reservations_not_self_reschedule.value: rescheduled_from_reservation_id IS NULL OR rescheduled_from_reservation_id <> id

chk_reservations_status_timestamps.name: chk_reservations_status_timestamps
chk_reservations_status_timestamps.value: (status = 'WAITLISTED' AND waitlisted_at IS NOT NULL AND cancelled_at IS NULL) OR (status = 'CONFIRMED' AND confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND cancelled_at IS NULL) OR (status = 'ATTENDED' AND confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND attendance_marked_at IS NOT NULL) OR (status = 'NO_SHOW' AND confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND (attendance_marked_at IS NOT NULL OR status_reason = 'LATE_CANCELLATION')) OR (status = 'CANCELLED' AND cancelled_at IS NOT NULL)

chk_reservations_status_reason.name: chk_reservations_status_reason
chk_reservations_status_reason.value: (status = 'CONFIRMED' AND status_reason IN ('MEMBER_BOOKED', 'WAITLIST_PROMOTED', 'RESCHEDULED')) OR (status = 'WAITLISTED' AND status_reason = 'MEMBER_JOINED_WAITLIST') OR (status = 'ATTENDED' AND status_reason = 'ATTENDANCE') OR (status = 'NO_SHOW' AND status_reason IN ('LATE_CANCELLATION', 'ATTENDANCE')) OR (status = 'CANCELLED' AND status_reason IN ('MEMBER_CANCELLED', 'ADMIN_CANCELLED', 'SESSION_CANCELLED', 'SERIES_CHANGED', 'WAITLIST_REMOVED', 'WAITLIST_EXPIRED', 'RESCHEDULED'))
